Theorem 1 (Chapter 128)

Subject: proteomics | ID: 46196

Statement

If A is a compact operator on a Hilbert space H, then the resolvent exists and is bounded for spectral values outside the spectrum.

Proof

Step 2. Applying the subharmonic interpolation theorem to \(S_{01280012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. By compactness of the smooth spectral family \(R_{01280013}\), the image is precompact in the Sobolev space topology.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via complex interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
